content: {"episode_id":"ep-05192","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) for episode ep-05192. The clinical indication note states the patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction and is \"currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations that raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia,\" consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes G45.9 and Z86.73. Per the note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered \"to capture continuous rhythm data during these symptomatic events to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to the patient's transient cerebral ischemic symptoms.\" We request review and reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 436.44 based on this documented medical necessity."}
